title: 1. Explore the representation
caption: This is the latent space view. Each dot is an example, and colours show its class. The suggestions sidebar is already open on the right.

title: 2. Get suggestions
caption: Click Get Suggestions and wait for the response. Read the proposed changes on the right. Dashed arrows preview the movements. Nothing is applied yet.

title: 3. Focus on the current classes
caption: Turn on this option to show only the classes in the current suggestion. Turn it off whenever you need the full picture.

title: 4. Adjust the proposal
caption: Watch the cursor drag the first arrow, then the second. Each arrow can be edited independently. Drag the dashed circle to make a group tighter.

title: 5. Edit an instruction
caption: Now edit the instruction in the text box. The backend asks the language model to interpret your words. Wait for the updated arrows, then review them.

title: 6. Apply the reviewed change
caption: Click Apply when the proposal looks right. The points move, and the log saves your words and the final movements together.

title: 7. Inspect the measured effect
caption: These measures describe the proposed change. They show movement size and class separation. A better layout does not always mean better accuracy.

title: 8. Complete a study task
caption: Enable Study mode, then click Begin or reset study task. Training stays locked. You have three interactions and five minutes. Watch the count and timer.

title: 9. Finish and return to the survey
caption: Collapse either sidebar when you want more space. After the task, return to the survey. Answer the questions, then stop and save the recording.
